newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy offers new issue CCTs for auction.
newsitem.headline: Italy offers new issue CCTs for auction.

text.p: The Italian Treasury said it will offer new issue seven year floating rate certificates (CCT) and re-open three, five and 10-year fixed rate bonds (BTP) at its regular end of month auction.
The Treasury said in a statement said it would offer:
* 11th tranche 1/07/96 3-yr BTPs paying a 8.25 percent coupon.
* 11th tranche 1/07/96 5-yr BTPs with a 8.25 percent coupon.
* 11th tranche 1/07/96 10-yr BTP with a 8.75 percent coupon.
* 1st tranche 1/09/96 7-yr CCTs paying an initial 4.55 percent coupon against a previous 4.30 pct coupon.
The amount of paper offered will be announced on Wednesday.
Subscriptions for the CCT and 10-year BTP auctions close at 1100 GMT on September 16.
Subscriptions for the three and five year BTP auctions close at 1100 GMT on September 17.
